hook.text: Before Gutenberg, a Bible took a monk two years to copy. After 1440, it took two days to print.

buildup.text: Movable type transformed writing from a craft for elites into a mass medium.

discovery.text: Printing standardized spelling, spread literacy, and made books affordable for the middle class.

twist.text: Korea invented movable metal type in the 1230s—200 years before Gutenberg—but it didn't spread as widely.

climax.text: The printing press is often called the most important invention of the second millennium.

punchline.text: Mass-produced words changed everything—politics, science, religion.

quiz.question: What major effect did the printing press have?
options: It standardized spelling and spread literacy
It was only used for religious texts
